description: LangChain is a framework for building applications powered by large language models (LLMs).
It helps developers connect LLMs with prompts, tools, data sources, memory, and application logic.
An LLM generates natural-language responses based on the input and context provided to it.
PromptTemplate is used to create reusable prompts with variables.
ChatPromptTemplate is used to create prompts containing different chat message roles such as system, human, and AI.
Document loaders import data from sources such as text files, CSV files, PDFs, and web pages.
TextLoader loads text from a .txt file into LangChain Document objects.
CSVLoader loads rows from a CSV file into LangChain Document objects.
A Document contains page content and metadata.
Text splitters divide large documents into smaller chunks for processing.
Embeddings convert text into numerical vectors so that semantic similarity can be calculated.
A vector store stores embeddings and allows similarity-based retrieval.
Retrieval-Augmented Generation retrieves relevant information and provides it to an LLM before generating an answer.
A retriever searches a data source or vector store for relevant documents.
Memory can be used to provide previous conversation information to an application.
Tools allow an LLM-based application to interact with external functions, APIs, databases, or services.
Agents can decide which tools to use to complete a task.
Chains connect multiple processing steps together to create an application workflow.
Output parsers help convert model responses into a desired structured format.
LangChain can be used for chatbots, document question answering, RAG systems, agents, and AI automation.
